children: FS Credit Opportunities elected Walter W. Buckley III as Class I Director; vote on Barbara J. Fouss postponed due to lack of preferred-stock quorum.
Walter W. Buckley III elected as Class I Director for a three-year term through 2029.
Election of Barbara J. Fouss adjourned because preferred-stock holders' quorum was not present at the Aug. 3 meeting.
Reconvened Meeting on Sept. 8 also lacked a preferred-stock quorum and was adjourned again.
Meeting rescheduled to reconvene Sept. 24, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. ET at the company's Philadelphia offices to consider Fouss's election.
